measurement.cold: scanner-cache cold; fixtures freshly written and page-cache warm
measurement.durationMs: production scan only; excludes fixture I/O and cache serialization
measurement.totalDurationMs: production scan plus cache stringify; excludes JSON.parse hydration
measurement.bytesRead: raw filesystem API bytes including checkpoint windows; excludes metadata calls
measurement.behaviorParity: exact legacy per-file and aggregate projections; excludes mtime and additive cache metadata
